scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one current supplier obligation traced through source-bound checks. The named obligation here is the selected record's dependency-head provenance table (and closely related publication fields), which reviewers treat as checked metadata. The historical owner-boundary timing omission is used only as the method pattern, not re-reported as a current bug.
bottleneck_link: Side result on acceptance reliability: closing a provenance-metadata gap strengthens trust in the selected record without changing the binding complex/bit budgets or kappa.
stop_rule: Finish the mutation audit of verify_selected_result on the named fields, the static scripts/ scan, the published consistency checks against frontier1042 and batch1099 integration reviewed_heads, and an opt-in proposed guard with positive/negative fixtures. Do not patch selected scripts or run the full cold frontier1094 replay.
evidence: PASS_SELECTED_DEPENDENCY_HEADS_AUDIT via research/selected-dependency-heads-audit/verify.py; EXPECTED.json; proposed guard.py rejects false heads/previous_kappa/source_prs mutants that the live checker accepts.
